name: JUNO
summary: JUNO is a large liquid-scintillator observatory in Guangdong built to resolve fine structure in reactor-antineutrino oscillations and determine the neutrino mass ordering. Its broad low-energy programme also covers solar, terrestrial and supernova neutrinos.
detection_principle: A high-light-yield scintillator target is viewed by large and small photomultiplier systems inside a water Cherenkov veto. Reactor antineutrinos are tagged through inverse beta decay; excellent energy calibration and resolution resolve the oscillation spectrum.

results.summary: The first 59 days of reactor data measured solar-sector oscillation parameters with improved precision. This early result validates detector performance; it is not a determination of mass ordering.
